title: Black Friday 2026 UK live deals: the best offers right now
seoTitle: Black Friday 2026 UK: Best Live Deals (Updated Today)
description: The best genuine UK Black Friday 2026 deals live right now, checked three times a day. Tech, home, beauty and toys, with prices compared.
intro:
**Last checked: Friday 20 November, 1:53pm.** The three standouts right now: the **Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition at £139.99** (its record low), the **Ring Battery Video Doorbell and Indoor Camera bundle at £39.99**, and the **Amazon Ember 65-inch Mini-LED TV at £709.99**, £440 off. All three are at Amazon and were still live this afternoon.

Black Friday 2026 is a week today, on Friday 27 November, and Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until 30 November. We check this page three times a day and remove anything that has sold out or gone back up. This afternoon we added the Ember 65-inch Mini-LED TV (£709.99) and the Philips Hue Essential Starter Kit (£64.99), and the Oura Ring 5 is now £299 in black and silver. We took off the Ninja Creami Soft Serve and the Blink camera and doorbell bundle because we couldn't re-confirm their prices this afternoon. Prices were reported on 19 and 20 November, so check the retailer's page before you buy.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition (2024, 32GB)
deals.note: Wireless charging, an auto-adjusting light and 32GB of storage. Still £139.99 in T3's Amazon picks this morning (20 November), the lowest price it has been. See our [Kindle Black Friday guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell + Ring Indoor Camera bundle
deals.note: A wire-free doorbell plus a plug-in indoor camera for about what the doorbell alone usually costs, still £39.99 this morning (20 November). The 'was' price adds the two list prices together, but £40 for both is still excellent. See our [Ring doorbell guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Garmin fēnix 8 (47mm)
deals.note: Garmin's top multisport watch with maps and a torch, still £484.99 this morning (20 November), which TechRadar calls its lowest-ever price. Which?'s six-month low on Amazon was about £553. Check the case size and screen type on the listing.

deals.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
deals.note: £45 under Apple's price and below the £175 to £183 they reached earlier this year. The AirPods to buy this Black Friday.

deals.name: Ninja Foodi Dual Zone 7.6L Air Fryer (AF300UK)
deals.note: The two-drawer Ninja most families buy. It was £125 to £128 last Black Friday, so this already beats it. More in our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max (latest model)
deals.note: The fastest Fire TV Stick, with Wi-Fi 6E and ambient mode, at more than half off on the first day of Amazon's Black Friday Week. Worth the extra £15 over the 4K if you stream a lot.

deals.name: Dyson V8 Origin Cordless Vacuum
deals.note: Dyson's cheapest current cordless at £130 off, still in Amazon's Black Friday picks this morning (20 November). Fine for flats and quick tidy-ups. More in our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Roborock Qrevo S Pro Robot Vacuum and Mop
deals.note: Vacuums and mops, then empties itself and washes its mop pads at the dock. £230 off makes it a mid-range price for a near top-end robot.

deals.name: Amazon Ember 50-inch 4K TV
deals.note: Amazon's own 4K TV with Fire TV built in, at its lowest price yet. A sensible bedroom or second-room TV. More in our [TV Black Friday guide](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Amazon Ember 65-inch Mini-LED QLED 4K TV
deals.note: Amazon's own Mini-LED TV with Fire TV built in, £440 off. The 55-inch is £559.99 and the 75-inch £959.99. Compare it with the OLEDs in our [TV Black Friday guide](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra (2025)
deals.note: Samsung's toughest smartwatch with a titanium case and multi-day battery, £250 off at Amazon (listed 19 November). Best with an Android phone; iPhone owners should look at Apple Watch instead.

deals.name: Oura Ring 5
deals.note: A sleep and recovery tracker you wear as a ring. The black and silver finishes are £299 (£100 off); Gold, Brushed Silver, Stealth and Deep Rose are £399. The app needs a monthly membership after the first month, so factor that in.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle (newest model, 16GB)
deals.note: The basic Kindle with a glare-free screen and adjustable light, £30 off. TechRadar expects this to be its lowest price until next year's Prime Day. The Paperwhite above is worth the extra £20 for its bigger, waterproof screen. Pair it with a [Kindle Unlimited free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku). See our [Kindle Black Friday guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Revlon Salon One-Step Hair Dryer and Volumiser
deals.note: Dries and adds volume in one go with a round brush head. £24.99 at Amazon (Currys is £25) is a record low and a good stocking filler. More haircare in our [ghd Black Friday guide](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Philips OneBlade 360
deals.note: Trims, edges and shaves with one flexible blade, and it's kind to sensitive skin. Holding at £39.99 all week, so it's an easy gift for anyone with stubble.

deals.name: Ninja Crispi Portable Glass Air Fryer
deals.note: Cooks in glass dishes you can serve from and store leftovers in. Under last year's Black Friday price of £117. Good for one or two people.

deals.name: Apple Watch Series 11 (42mm, GPS)
deals.note: £50 off Apple's price (reported 19 November). The 46mm version is £299. The Apple Watch to buy if you have an iPhone.

deals.name: Nothing Ear (3a) Wireless Earbuds
deals.note: Noise-cancelling earbuds with a clear, punchy sound for £40 off. A cheaper alternative to AirPods; see our [AirPods Black Friday guide](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/) for Apple prices.

deals.name: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum gift set
deals.note: The Perfume Shop lists it at £56.24 after its 25% off, a saving of £44.76. One of the best-selling women's gift sets; check the bottle size on the listing. See our [perfume gift sets guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/).

deals.name: Sonos Move 2 Portable Speaker
deals.note: A big-sounding battery speaker that works on Wi-Fi at home and Bluetooth in the garden. £90 off at Amazon, still live on 19 November.

deals.name: Philips Hue Essential Starter Kit (bridge and smart bulbs)
deals.note: The cheapest way to start with Hue smart lighting, 41% off at Amazon. Works with Alexa, Google and Apple Home.

deals.name: Philips Hue Festavia Smart String Lights (20m)
deals.note: App-controlled Christmas tree lights with gradient effects, 30% off at Amazon this morning (19 November), with an extra voucher on some listings. Festavia usually sells for £149 to £264 depending on length. Needs a Hue Bridge for the full feature set.

deals.name: LEGO Festive Gingerbread House
deals.note: A Christmas build that doubles as a decoration year after year. 20% off is a fair price for a seasonal set. More in our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar 2026
deals.note: It needs to arrive by 1 December, so there's no point waiting. Every set is in our [Lego advent calendar 2026 guide](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/).

deals.name: LEGO Icons The Lord of the Rings: Rivendell (10316)
deals.note: The huge 6,000-plus-piece Rivendell display set at 18% off on Amazon (listed 19 November). A big one-off gift for adult Lego fans. More in our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/).

body:
## Tech

The best tech deals right now are on Amazon's own devices: the Kindle Paperwhite Signature, the Ring doorbell bundle, and the Fire TV Stick 4K Max at £46.99. The standard Kindle is £119.99 too. The Garmin fēnix 8 at £484.99 is the standout watch deal, and the Apple Watch Series 11 is £269 for iPhone owners. Echo speakers are only modestly cut so far (the Echo Spot is £54.99), so they may drop further this week. We've taken the Surface Laptop off until we can confirm which version is on offer, as reported prices differ. Amazon's own Ember 50-inch 4K TV is at its lowest price yet at £269.99, and the Ember 65-inch Mini-LED is £709.99 (£440 off). For wearables, the Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra is £349 (£250 off) and the Oura Ring 5 is £299 in black or silver. For audio, the AirPods Pro 3 are at a record-low £174, Nothing Ear (3a) earbuds are £59 and the Sonos Move 2 portable speaker is £359. We've dropped the Beats deals until we can confirm they're still live.

More: [Kindle](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ring doorbells](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/), [AirPods](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/), [TVs](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Amazon Black Friday 2026](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## Home & kitchen

Ninja's air fryers are already at or below last year's Black Friday prices, so there's little reason to wait. The Dyson V8 Origin at £199.99 (Amazon) is the standout cordless vacuum deal, the Roborock Qrevo S Pro self-emptying robot vacuum and mop is £319.99 (£230 off), Philips Hue Festavia smart Christmas lights are 30% off at £119.99, and the Hue Essential Starter Kit is £64.99. The Ninja Creami Soft Serve is off the list until we can re-confirm its price. The Dyson V15 Detect Absolute deals have ended (it's back to about £649), so we've removed it; see our [Dyson V15 guide](/guides/dyson-v15-deals-uk/) for the price to wait for.

More: [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/), [coffee machines](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Beauty

The Revlon One-Step volumiser is at a record-low £24.99 at Amazon, the Philips OneBlade 360 is £39.99, and ghd has cut the Duet Style hot air styler to £259 (£120 off) on its own site. Perfume gift sets are now properly discounted: The Perfume Shop has Lancôme La Vie Est Belle at £56.24, and Superdrug's Black Friday fragrance event runs until 1 December. Amazon sells most of the same sets, so [compare Amazon's perfume gift set prices](https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=perfume+gift+set) before you buy.

More: [perfume gift sets](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/), [ghd](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Oral-B](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Toys & gifts

Advent calendars need to arrive by 1 December, so buy those now. The Lego Festive Gingerbread House is £28 at Amazon, a good one to build together in December. For a bigger Lego gift, Amazon has Rivendell at £350. For toys, Hamleys is running its own Black Friday event, and our guide shows what's worth buying there. Switch 2 bundles are worth checking again as Amazon's sale goes on.

More: [Hamleys Black Friday 2026](/guides/hamleys-black-friday-2026/), [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Lego advent calendars](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/) and [Nintendo Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## How we pick these deals

Every price comes from the retailer or a trusted deals source dated today or yesterday. We compare it with price history and last year's Black Friday prices, and we leave out deals where the 'was' price is inflated. When Amazon matches the cheapest shop, we link Amazon. Many Amazon prices need Prime during Black Friday Week; our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time a trial.

### When is Black Friday 2026 in the UK?

Friday 27 November, with Cyber Monday on 30 November. Our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer's dates.

### Should I buy now or wait for Black Friday?

If a deal here is marked 'Lowest price', it's already at or below last year's Black Friday price, so buy it. Items marked 'Good price' could still fall a little in the final week.

### How often is this page updated?

Three times a day, every day until Cyber Monday. Deals that end or go up in price are removed.

See [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) for brand-by-brand prices to wait for.
